claimText: Thiagarajar College of Engineering is a government-aided autonomous college in Madurai, Tamil Nadu. Its current programme directory covers engineering, architecture, interior design, computing and urban planning, including a five-year integrated Data Science route. It is a distinct institution from Thiagarajar College, the arts and science college.
The institution About page states founding in 1957; an AICTE approval file has a different establishment-year field and is not used to replace institutional history.
internalNotes: Rendered EOA page 1 reads 1995, not the OCR result 1955. Treat as a source conflict/regulatory field; verify if public history is contested.

claimText: The college publishes separate men’s and women’s hostel pages, including warden contacts and links to general, maintenance, discipline and mess information. The women’s hostel page explicitly makes accommodation subject to availability. No current room price is confirmed in this draft.

Both hostel sections link mess information. The captured pages do not establish a current menu, special-diet provision or allergy-handling arrangements, so students should ask the relevant hostel office about individual requirements.

The college’s counselling cell operates at the campus health centre. Its official page describes a tutor–ward system and tele-counselling service, and a link with Chella Muthu Trust Research Foundation for counsellor orientation and training.

Thiagarajar College of Engineering is based at Thiruparankundram in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, with the official postal address Madurai 625015. Students should plan housing and daily travel around this engineering-college campus, rather than the separate Thiagarajar College arts and science institution.

TCE describes a CDIO approach—Conceive, Design, Implement and Operate—to curriculum design, teaching and assessment, with hands-on training. Its About page also identifies industry-supported laboratories, collaborative projects and internships, including curriculum work with TVS Motors in mechanical and electrical engineering. Availability depends on the programme and activity; no placement is guaranteed.

TCE’s mandatory disclosure identifies a grievance-redressal mechanism for students, staff and faculty, and lists medical facilities and student insurance. Its counselling division operates at the campus health centre. Applicants should verify current access arrangements rather than assume round-the-clock emergency coverage.

TNEA 2026 applies to government-aided and participating engineering courses. The academic stream requires both HSC years and a Class XII Mathematics/Physics/Chemistry average of 45% for general or 40% for the listed reserved categories. Nativity/schooling/parental-service conditions apply. Only the explicitly permitted Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO and Sri Lankan Tamil refugee categories are included, not unrestricted foreign-national admission.
